title: Form, Circulation & Return Atlas v1
description: Exact closed schema for the immutable 2026-08-13 form, circulation, and return companion atlas.

title.const: Form, Circulation & Return

focus.const: An additive deep companion to the immutable Cultural Attention & Feedback Atlas: a bounded translation between material-form accessibility, cultural-variant circulation, finite attention, mathematical description, feedback, KARMA, and philosophical questions.

intended_use.const: Education, source tracing, model selection, challenge, and safer infrastructure design.

excluded_use.const: Medical or clinical advice, diagnosis, treatment, prognosis, experiment or wet-lab design, formulation or manufacturing control, operational protocols, person or community classification, causal attribution, content ranking, moderation, reward, economics, governance, or automatic action.

observation_policy.const: Every observation stays qualified by subject, corpus or process, procedure, time window, threshold, observed result, exclusions, and uncertainty.

question.const: What useful shape connects a disappearing polymorph, meme circulation, finite attention, feedback, KARMA, and questions about design without pretending they are the same thing?

prefixItems.const: Several states or variants may be possible while history and boundary conditions change which ones are easy to reach or observe.
Local reinforcement can sometimes create a large aggregate pattern; saturation, correction, refusal, and decay can limit or redirect it.
A crystal form is not a cultural artifact, a cultural artifact is not its meaning, and none of them is a person or mind.
Exposure, sharing, remixing, interpretation, endorsement, belief, and behavior are different observations.
Popularity, persistence, entropy, and model growth are not truth, quality, harm, consent, destiny, or moral worth.
KARMA preserves accountable relation and aftermath without converting engagement into a score, balance, reward, or vote.
Questions about universal design are opt-in philosophy; the scientific sources neither prove nor disprove them.

safety.const: Static educational metadata only. The historical ritonavir case grants no medical, clinical, treatment, prognosis, experiment, wet-lab, formulation, manufacturing, or operational-protocol authority. The slang label ‘brainrot’ is not a diagnosis or property of a person or community. No runtime request, tracking, person inference, KARMA write, reward, governance effect, or automatic action occurs.

rule.const: A polymorph and a meme variant are not the same kind of entity or mechanism.
A material seed and a cultural precedent or share are not equivalent.
Cultural circulation must not make people hosts, vectors, or pathogens.
Aggregate attention is not an individual cognitive state.
‘Brainrot’ remains a contested contextual label for artifacts or practices, never a diagnosis or person attribute.
An equation is not an observation and an unfitted parameter is not a measured fact.
Reach, growth, persistence, and centrality do not establish truth, quality, benefit, harm, or moral worth.
A preserved abstract relation never imports a mechanism across domains.
Engagement and model outputs do not become KARMA, receipts, balances, rewards, ranks, or votes.
A philosophical reading cannot be cited as empirical evidence.
